title: Regional Headroom Optimizer — Weekly Sheet (2026-08-12)
body:
Description:
This sheet is an operational export used by oncall and capacity planners to identify short-term headroom opportunities across regions and clusters and to recommend low-risk workload reshuffles for the coming 72 hours. The emphasis is on small, reversible moves and applying slack budgets before triggering expensive burst capacity or preemption policies.

Notes on methodology:
- Data pulled from telemetry snapshot at 2026-08-12T02:00Z (rolling 1h percentile windows).
- Utilization = used_gpu_seconds / available_gpu_seconds over the sample window.
- Headroom target = min(available * 0.20, cluster_specific_slack).
- Candidate moves only include pools with >8% fractional slack and <70% steady-state utilization.

Summary by region (aggregated):
Region,Total GPUs,Used GPUs,Available GPUs,Avg Util %,Headroom GPU equiv,Short-term opportunity
NA,2,640,1,986,654,75.3,528,apply policy: shift non-latent batch to pool-north-batch (est +120 GPUs)
EU,1,120,842,278,75.1,222,preemptible batch reschedule window 02:00-06:00 UTC (est +80 GPUs)
APAC,880,712,168,80.9,140,constrained; recommend targeted cache priming + KV reuse to avoid burst requests

Per-cluster snapshot (selected clusters only):
Cluster,Pool,Capacity GPUs,Used GPUs,Util %,Observed microburst count (24h),Fragmentation index,Headroom shortfall,Action suggested
na-cluster-03,pool-north-batch,256,190,74.2,14,0.12,0,move 32 GPUs of staged training to pool-north-batch-2 overnight
na-cluster-07,pool-north-latency,128,118,92.2,3,0.05,-5,reduce soft concurrency from 12->9 (can free ~6 GPUs)
eu-cluster-02,pool-eu-general,192,150,78.1,9,0.18,10,evict low-priority embeddings jobs to preemptible window
apac-cluster-05,pool-apac-cache,120,104,86.7,25,0.32,30,high fragmentation: propose consolidation and NVMe cache tuning

Opportunity matrix (short list of reversible actions):
- Move candidate workloads:
  * NA: move 120 GPU batch from pool-north-batch-standby -> pool-north-batch (expected headroom +120). Risk: low. Tickets: INFRA-2901
  * EU: shift nightly embedding rebuild to preemptible schedule (est +80 GPUs at 02:00-06:00 UTC). Risk: medium. Measure: tail latency change.
- Concurrency tuning:
  * na-cluster-07: reduce per-slot concurrency for latency pool to gain ~6 GPUs; monitor 30m. Risk: high for latency-sensitive routes.
- Cache + KV reuse:
  * apac clusters show high microburst counts: add prefix-level KV caching and extend TTL for small prompt caching (est reduce microburst frequency by 40%).

Observations and anomalies to escalate:
- apac-cluster-05 shows elevated fragmentation index (0.32) and repeated microbursts between 12:00-16:00 JST; suspected pattern from customer X heavy autoregressive bursts. Recommend engagement with Solutions Eng.
- na-cluster-07 latency pool nearing soft-concurrency cap; if traffic grows >6% this week, schedule canary for auto-scale-exempt capacity reserve.

Quick action checklist (for oncall):
- [ ] Approve NA batch move (INFRA-2901) — owner: Marcus Liu — target execution window 2026-08-13 01:00-04:00 UTC
- [ ] Shift EU embeddings job to preemptible window — owner: Priya Kapoor — test schedule on 2026-08-13
- [ ] Create ticket for APAC fragmentation deep-dive (owner: Diego Ramirez) — include sample logs and microburst trace

Concluding note:
This sheet should be re-run at the same snapshot cadence (daily 02:00 UTC) and used as the source for the weekly headroom retrospective. If any recommended moves are executed, update the "move_outcomes" row in the Confluence page CONF-1421 within 24h.
